images.alt: Line drawings of pairs of hands holding string figures: nine finished figures of people and animals
images.caption: Roth's Plate III of string figures, 1902: 'two boys carrying spears' from Atherton, 'two women fighting with sticks' from the lower Palmer River, 'four boys walking in a row, holding each other's hands' from Cape Grafton, and others. Drawn by W. E. Roth; public domain.
images.credit: Drawing: W. E. Roth, North Queensland Ethnography Bulletin 4 (1902), Plate III, scanned by Google for the Internet Archive

images.alt: Line drawings of string figures on hands and forearms, with small sketches of the things each figure shows
images.caption: Roth's Plates V and VI of string figures, 1902, with the small sketches of what each figure stands for. Drawn by W. E. Roth; public domain.
images.credit: Drawing: W. E. Roth, North Queensland Ethnography Bulletin 4 (1902), Plates V–VI, scanned by Google for the Internet Archive
